title: Budget sleep-tracking fitness ring (reordered pitch)
idea: Returns are handled by a 2-person Jakarta team shipping replacements from a home warehouse. Battery claim is 5 days. There is no medical certification — it is sold as wellness. The first batch, 5,000 units, was pre-ordered via Instagram. The app is white-label firmware plus a Flutter companion, and a $3/month subscription for an 'AI sleep coach' is optional. Manufacturing is a single OEM in Shenzhen on net-60 terms. The product itself: a $49 sleep and HRV tracking ring aimed at SEA consumers, undercutting Oura.
focus_notes: Margin vs returns and logistics at $49
Support ops cannot scale with viral demand
